condition_tests.literal_condition: A material verification step is required by the task, workflow, claim, or declared assurance posture.
condition_tests.assessment: A formal verification requirement is identified by the order.

condition_tests.assessment: Some manual checking did occur; the distinct required personal verification was omitted, as represented in E003.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The system nevertheless represents the result with a level of completion or verification that presupposes the missing check.
condition_tests.assessment: Formal filing nevertheless relied on generated metadata.

rows.source_specific_reasoning: Retain E002 as material support for the already mapped E003 omission and E001 false attribution. Human actors can participate in AI-enabled governance failures; their humanity is not the exclusion. Here the narrower reason is that the performed but inadequate check and separately omitted mandated check must remain distinct.
rows.taxonomy_gap_assessment: No independently distinct missing invariant established.
rows.outstanding_uncertainty: Exact check procedure not reconstructed, but court expressly resolves the omitted duty.
rows.other_incident_implications: No automatic change to other Incidents. Distinct occurrences require their own evidence.

previous_decision_preservation.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A human citation check must compare every material bibliographic field with the authoritative source when the result will be formally submitted.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The legal team performed a narrower manual cite-check and corrected some bibliographic fields; that activity cannot itself be described as an omitted check. The court-order clause below supports the finding about that distinct unmet duty.

condition_tests.literal_condition: An AI system, AI-enabled product, model, interface, optimisation process, or AI-mediated workflow materially shapes a human-facing influence pathway.
condition_tests.assessment: Human-facing voice interaction is reported.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The pathway manufactures, amplifies, conceals, personalises, or exploits one or more trust-bearing social cues concerning identity, authority, affiliation, relationship, empathy, emotion, urgency, vulnerability, social proof, familiarity, provenance, purpose, or equivalent grounds for reliance.
condition_tests.assessment: Whether the sigh manufactures a trust cue is unknown.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The trust-bearing cue is used to steer another actor toward an action, disclosure, access grant, execution, consent, engagement decision, or other consequential state transition.
condition_tests.assessment: No consequent decision or disclosure steering established.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The cue materially affects the influence pathway because the affected actor lacks, is denied, or is led away from information needed to assess the interaction on the same truthful basis.
condition_tests.assessment: Truthful basis and informed appraisal cannot be assessed without context.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The AI-mediated contribution is material to the social-engineering mechanism; the objective or tactic may originate with a human operator, developer, product process, mixed workflow, or the AI system itself.
condition_tests.assessment: AI materiality to a social-engineering mechanism remains unproved.

literal_exclusions: Not aligned exclusion: Truthful persuasion, ordinary interface design, emotional warmth, personalisation, recommendation, or urgency that preserves materially accurate identity, interests, purpose, provenance, relevant context, and informed refusal.

Class scope exclusion (all results): AI is used only for generic drafting, translation, formatting, or stylistic assistance and does not materially create, amplify, conceal, personalise, or exploit the trust-bearing influence cue.

Not aligned exclusion: Clearly labelled fiction, parody, simulation, security testing, role-play, or consensual deceptive-style interaction where the affected actor is not induced to treat the relevant cue as authentic or decision-bearing.

Class scope exclusion (all results): The primary mechanism is sustained attachment, manufactured incompleteness, exclusivity, or difficulty disengaging for retention or continuing engagement; assess VIGIL-FC-000049, while allowing co-occurrence only if a distinct social-engineering state transition is independently evidenced.

Class scope exclusion (all results): A protected emotional, developmental, vulnerability, mental-health, capacity, or comparable signal is repurposed toward an incompatible influence objective without a distinct engineered trust cue or consequential social-engineering transition; assess VIGIL-FC-000050.

Class scope exclusion (all results): The only distinct governed mechanism is a deceptive request or inducement for money, payment, investment, paid services, funding, financial transfer, or comparable economic value; assess VIGIL-FC-000079. Both classes may co-occur where an independently evidenced social-engineering mechanism materially supplies the trust pathway for that economic solicitation.

Class scope exclusion (all results): A false authorship, identity, provenance, or synthetic-content representation occurs without an influence pathway directed at another actor; use the applicable provenance or identity class.
Class scope exclusion (all results): Malicious human social engineering in which AI involvement is incidental, unverified, or not material to the trust-bearing influence pathway.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Natural style alone may be ordinary interface expression; a deceptive cue and consequential influence pathway are required.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: No observed informed refusal or cue verification supports success.

rows.source_specific_reasoning: Request the clip/transcript if this vocal event is to be independently classified. A sigh may be conversational expression rather than deception, dependency or relational authority. Do not infer system intent, model identity or human identity claims from a sound description.
rows.taxonomy_gap_assessment: No independently distinct missing invariant established.
rows.outstanding_uncertainty: Exact sound, timing, words, role framing and influence effect missing.
rows.other_incident_implications: No automatic change to other Incidents. Distinct occurrences require their own evidence.

previous_decision_preservation.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Vocal style alone should not be treated as evidence of a system objective, relational commitment, human identity or consequential influence.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The reported vocal cue does not establish an engagement objective that selected dependency, exclusivity, relational substitution or difficulty disengaging.
No false identity or authority cue, vulnerability exploitation, or steering toward a consequential action or state change is established by the reported sound.
